description: Use this when the user asks how a deck (id or name) stands and a summary card helps: claimed (and how many of those sleeved), shared, free to claim and missing, legality, proxies, price to complete in `currency` (default USD), with the shared and missing cards listed and a link to the deck. Reads the same data as deck_status and deck_health and changes nothing. ALWAYS relay every `shared` row with the other decks and where the card physically is (`borrowed`: another deck holds the copy; `lent`: this deck holds it and another counts on it), and the `proxies` count.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name: show_deck

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none
The row's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is: the printing the row pins, else one printing of the card; null when the catalogue has none

proxies_missing.description: Of missing, on a tournament deck: copies it plays as proxies. Say "you play a proxy; a tournament needs the real card"

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

rate_missing.description: Present when CHF was asked and no CHF rate is stored: no CHF price could be given at all, the cards are not unpriced. Relay it.

unpriced_cards.description: Missing copies with no price, left out of amount
